brief:
Israeli settlers targeted a fourth house under construction in Qusra on Saturday, according to Middle East Eye. Six Palestinian residents had gathered at the property to install protective metal netting when the attack occurred.

The multiple assaults on homes in a single day reflect the frequency of settler violence targeting Palestinian communities in the occupied West Bank. Residents have begun installing metal netting on structures as a protective measure against repeated attacks. The escalation comes as tensions remain high in villages like Qusra, where settlers and Palestinians have clashed repeatedly over land and property disputes.
